scope: A valid v3.5 sticky predecessor with exactly one derived common-core state, complete target-component coverage, and zero target Cartesian-product enumeration. After conditioning every target relation on the unique common-core state and removing core coordinates, build the exact relation-overlap graph from raw residual scopes. Every residual connected component must contain one or two target relations. Components are solved independently and stored as an additive boundary portfolio.

formal_mechanism.conditioning: Reuse the exact v3.5 common-core state s and keep only rows whose core projection equals s, preserving original-row provenance.
formal_mechanism.residual_graph: Vertices are target relations. Add an edge iff two residual scopes D_i=scope(R_i)\C share at least one variable. Canonical connected components are derived before any pair join.
formal_mechanism.singleton_component: Existentially project factor-local private variables to residual boundary variables B_i=D_i∩B. Store exact boundary tuples plus one original-row witness per boundary tuple.
formal_mechanism.pair_component: For exactly two conditioned relations, perform exactly one natural join on all shared residual variables, then existentially project non-boundary residual variables. Store one pair of original rows as reconstruction provenance per boundary tuple. The explicit pair comparison envelope is at most |R_i||R_j| <= O(L^2).
formal_mechanism.three_plus_component: Return OPEN_RESIDUAL_COMPONENT_GT2 before any join-chain or component Cartesian materialization.
formal_mechanism.portfolio: Store singleton/pair component boundary carriers additively. Never materialize a Cartesian product across residual components.
formal_mechanism.handoff: Replace the entire target component by the derived component-boundary factors, preserve all other cut-separated constraints, and invoke the unchanged sealed guarded-elimination engine with the original canonical cut and frozen L^2 policy.
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: Restore the unique core state, use transformed boundary assignments to select stored singleton rows or pair-row witnesses independently per residual component, merge assignments on disjoint residual components, and replay every original relation.
formal_mechanism.complexity: Residual graph discovery is polynomial in explicit scope incidence. Each singleton is linear in its explicit rows. Each pair performs one O(|R_i||R_j| * poly(scope)) exact join, bounded by O(L^2 * poly(L)); components are additive and number at most O(L). No exponent depends on relation count.

negative_controls.construction: From the positive pair-coupled sticky control, restrict the two coupled conditioned factors to contradictory values of their shared residual variable while preserving the unique common-core predecessor surface.
Make three sticky payload factors share one residual variable while preserving the unique common-core sticky predecessor.
